main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Free yourself from the Demiurge: Your consciousness transcends matter
header_desc: By intertwining 1st-century spirituality with 21st-century physics, this work addresses the fundamental question about our place in the universe. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in two-thousand-year-old texts: the Gnostic gospels.
left_title: The Return ✝️ to the ONE ❤️: The ego 🧠 has mass ┻
left_body: Matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. If the ego curves spacetime, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche, and the timeless responds to the pneuma. Consciousness oscillates between the states $vert$ ONE $angle$ and $vert$ EGO $angle$, granting us free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to shed the false self and return to the pure light of the Invisible Father.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere lies the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension $vert$ 999⟩. There is the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom is within and outside you – Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): the timeless light of feeling in the right hemisphere versus the temporal density of thought in the left hemisphere shows the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension $vert$ 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: I invite you to invert the map ✝️ of reality for the awakening of the ONE ❤️.
p2_sub: From Material Prison to Pleroma of Light: A Journey through Gnosis and Physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle
cap1_desc: The meeting between the intuitive heart of the South and the rational mind of the North. The awakening of collective consciousness through the reconciliation of spirit and science.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Illusion of Time
cap2_desc: Time as an emergent construct. Theoretical unification where the geometry of the cosmos converges with the timeless structure of quantum reality.
cap3_desc: Reality as a phenomenon of observation and perception. The collapse of the fundamental state and the quantum dynamics between pure presence and the observer.
cap4_desc: The origin of physical order according to the Gnostic gospels: the emanation of Sophia versus the material architecture of Yaldabaoth and the carbon-12 matrix.
cap5_desc: Quantum formalization of the ego's mass: the curvature induced by mental attachment and the equation of free will in the oscillation ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres
cap6_desc: The blindness of the spiritual eye and the tyrannical dominance of the left hemisphere (disconnected reason) versus the integrative vision of the right hemisphere and the heart.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos
cap7_desc: Return to the Invisible Father: the ultimate liberation from the temporal illusion, the dissolution of the material prison, and awakening in the full light of the Pleroma.
sagan_quote: The idea of God as a larger-than-normal white man with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity
